deleteBody: This removes the model from your library. The .glb file itself stays in Shopify Files, and any page still embedding it will stop rendering.
resetBody: Every viewer setting for this model goes back to its default. The model file and its name are untouched.
modelIdHint: This model’s permanent identifier — the same id used in its viewer link below.
shareIntro: A public page that renders this model with the settings saved below. Anyone with the link can view it; it isn’t indexed by search engines.
viewerLanguageDetails: Buttons and labels, plus your hotspot translations for that language.
embedHelp: Paste into any page that accepts HTML — a Shopify page in the HTML view, a theme Custom Liquid section, a blog post, or a site outside Shopify. Responsive keeps a 4:3 box at any width; Fixed pins the saved height.
embedParamsHelp: Append ?bg=101014 to the URL to match a dark page (hex, no #), or ?autorotate=0 to stop it spinning — per placement, without touching the saved settings.
viewerSettingsIntro: Saved with this library entry, and used by the public viewer page.
stillProcessing: This file is still processing in Shopify Files. Refresh in a moment to see the preview.
